title: Confirm dialog
description: confirmDialog() asks one yes / no question and resolves to true or false; confirmDelete({ name }) is the irreversible-action form (names the object, red Xoá). Mount ConfirmHost once in the root layout. Never window.confirm.
when: Before an irreversible action: delete, stop a print, discard changes. confirmDelete names the object.
A reversible action does not ask: do it and offer toast.undo.
a11y: An alertdialog: focus starts on the safe button (Huỷ) in a danger dialog and on the confirm button otherwise; Escape cancels.
The message describes the dialog (aria-describedby); while it scrolls it is focusable, so arrow keys scroll it.

examples.title: Irreversible delete
examples.description: confirmDelete: the title names the object, the button is red and says Xoá.

examples.title: Long message
examples.description: The panel stays inside the screen (92dvh): the message scrolls with a soft edge, the title and the buttons always show.

notes: <ConfirmHost /> goes once in the root layout (see Theme › Root layout); confirmDialog() works from any event handler.
confirmDelete takes deleteTitle(name), deleteMessage and delete from the locale provider around ConfirmHost (English with locale={en}).
